title: Tracks in the house
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, isolated log cabin on a snowy mountain during a blizzard, cold blue moonlight against warm firelight, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. The wet footprints stopped at her brother's bed. 👣

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: the thing at the door spoke in their father's voice, and Caleb slid the bolt open.
scenes.image: a cabin door with its iron bolt open, snow drifting across the floor

scenes.narration: Nora slammed it shut. The porch was empty. Caleb swore he never touched the bolt. He stared at his own hand like it belonged to a stranger.
scenes.image: man staring at his open hand in firelight, a woman holding a door shut behind him

scenes.narration: They didn't sleep until dawn. When Nora woke, the fire was out. And the floor was wet.
scenes.image: wooden cabin floor with puddles of melting snow in grey morning light

scenes.narration: Puddles. In a line. Snowmelt, still cold, still holding tiny flecks of ice.
scenes.image: close-up of a puddle of meltwater with ice crystals on dark floorboards

scenes.narration: They started inside the front door. Long, narrow, bare feet. Spaced too far apart.
scenes.image: wet bare footprints leading across floorboards away from a closed front door

scenes.narration: They went past the fireplace. Past Nora's room, where they stopped, toes pointed at her door. Then they moved on.
scenes.image: wet footprints pausing in front of a closed bedroom door in a dim hallway

scenes.narration: They ended at Caleb's bed. Not beside it. At it. Like something had stood there all night, watching him breathe.
scenes.image: rumpled bed in a small cabin bedroom, wet footprints ending at its edge, cold morning light

scenes.narration: Caleb was sitting on the mattress. Calm. Too calm. He said: I dreamed Dad tucked me in.
scenes.image: a pale man sitting on the edge of a bed, eerily calm, frost on the window behind him

scenes.narration: Nora touched his arm. Ice cold. And when he smiled at her, his breath didn't fog. Not at all.
scenes.image: close-up of a man smiling in a freezing room, frost on his eyelashes, no breath visible

scenes.narration: Far down the mountain, an engine. The snowplow. They were getting out. Caleb looked toward the window and said, in a voice that wasn't quite his: good. I've always wanted to see the city.
scenes.image: orange snowplow headlights climbing a snowy mountain road far below a cabin window
